verdict.rationale: Entra ID documents background automation within its identity domain. Lifecycle Workflows contain processes that "run automatically against users" as they move through joiner, mover and leaver phases. Automatic SCIM provisioning syncs users and groups into SaaS and on-premises apps. These automations are limited to identity governance and provisioning rather than general user-defined automations. missing for 10: general-purpose or custom automation authoring, documented scheduling/trigger configuration and run monitoring, any AI or agent-driven automation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
